description: This file defines the interface for a message queue system used to cache and process messages with filtering, processing, and notification capabilities. It includes type definitions, function prototypes, and documentation for managing message lifecycle, sets, and thread control.

classes.name: messageQueue
classes.description: Opaque structure representing the message queue instance.

classes.name: messageQueueDelegate
classes.description: Structure holding function pointers for filtering, processing, and notifying messages.

methods.name: messageQueueCreate
methods.description: Creates a new message queue with specified delegate, concurrency, and timeout.

methods.name: messageQueueDestroy
methods.description: Destroys the message queue and all contained messages.

methods.name: messageQueueStartThread
methods.description: Starts the processing thread for the queue.

methods.name: messageQueueStopThread
methods.description: Stops the processing thread, optionally waiting for exit.

methods.name: messageQueueAppend
methods.description: Adds a message to the queue, placing it in the filter set if it matches.

methods.name: messageQueueRemove
methods.description: Removes a message by ID from all sets and destroys it.

methods.name: messageQueueClear
methods.description: Clears and destroys all messages in the queue.

methods.name: messageQueueIterate
methods.description: Iterates over messages in specified set, applying a callback.

methods.name: messageQueueCompleted
methods.description: Marks a message as completed by ID, returning the message for further handling.

methods.name: messageQueueCompletedCustomSearch
methods.description: Marks a message as completed using a custom search function.

methods.name: messageQueueAllSetCount
methods.description: Returns the count of all messages.

methods.name: messageQueueFilterSetCount
methods.description: Returns the count of filtered messages.

methods.name: messageQueueSentSetCount
methods.description: Returns the count of sent messages.

methods.name: messageQueueGetMaxProcessingMessageCount
methods.description: Gets the maximum number of concurrent processing messages.

methods.name: messageQueueSetMaxProcessingMessageCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of concurrent processing messages.

methods.name: messageQueueGetMessageTimeoutSecs
methods.description: Gets the message timeout in seconds.

methods.name: messageQueueSetMessageTimeoutSecs
methods.description: Sets the message timeout in seconds.

methods.name: messageQueueRunFilter
methods.description: Re-runs the filter on all messages to update the filter set.

methods.name: messageQueueIsBusy
methods.description: Checks if the queue is actively processing a message.

methods.name: messageQueueContainsMessage
methods.description: Checks if a specific message exists in the queue.
